messages.author: 953deaf1a512b96e
messages.subject: Re: Time varying covariates in cox model
parts:
Hi,
Yes it's possible, the trick is to decompose the follow-up into intervals (as done with Cox) and and use left truncation / right censoring for the intervals in-between entry and event time. For example I have an event at time 3, I can create 3 intervals: 0->1 (right censored), 1->2 (left truncated and right censored) and 2->3 (left truncated and observed event). Then each interval can have a different value for the time-varying covariate.
Best,
Denis Rustand
he...@r-inla.org
